passage: L1.2: "Using the entire dataset for any pre-processing steps, such as imputation or over/under sampling, results in leakage." (Results, 'Toward a solution: A taxonomy of data leakage', PMC10499856). Target encoding is the subtype's listed example in the task's closed list, not a phrase of the quoted sentence.
faulty: Each of the 150 districts is encoded by the mean of y over all rows of that district, using all 1200 rows (a district with no row gets the grand mean); ordinary least squares of y on [encoded value, 3 covariates, intercept] with 5-fold cross-validation (fold = i mod 5), the encoding of a held-out row being the all-rows district mean; pooled Pearson correlation between predictions and y >= 0.25.
fixed: In each fold the district means are computed from the 960 training rows only; training rows use their own training mean and held-out rows use the training mean of their district (grand training mean if the district is absent); OLS fitted on the training rows, predicts the held-out rows; pooled Pearson correlation >= 0.25.
estimand: Faulty: the correlation of predictions whose encoded feature contains the held-out row's own outcome (about 8 rows per district). Fixed: the out-of-sample correlation for new patients, whose outcome is unknown when the district is encoded.
model_family: Mean (target) encoding of the district followed by ordinary least squares with 3 covariates and an intercept. Source names no model; the encoding is the pre-processing step with labels.
sizes_note: Source states none. 1200 x 150 bool = 180,000 values plus 1200 x 3; about 8 rows per district is the proposed note value (the leak size grows as districts get smaller); the check is 5 OLS fits on 5 regressors. Dependence of the error on sample size or category size: not stated.
exploited_structure: Many small categories, so the mean outcome of a category is dominated by the outcomes of its few rows, including the row being scored.

structure_statistic.note_value_source: source states none: 150 occupied districts / 1200 patients (about 8 per district) is the brief's own size; proposed, not a source value

notes: Guard: correlation None below 2 held-out rows or zero variance of predictions or y; non-finite returns None.
